calculators.name: Stock Machining - Material Stock
calculators.description: Material Stock: the stock as supplied (memory operation As Supplied; its machine has no operator and no rate). It holds the bar or plate each part is cut from (Stock Machining - Bar Stock or Plate Stock) and takes no machine time: no line is costed for it. A face of the part that lies on the stock's surface where no stock is left on it is used as supplied.

source.engine: stock_mass_kg (the stock bought per part: Stock Machining - Bar Stock or Plate Stock)

calculators.name: Stock Machining - Stock Size
calculators.description: The size of stock a part needs: its outside size (its largest diameter, its width across flats, or a side of its section) plus the stock left on each side. The allowance is a percent of the outside size, at least a least and at most a most (percentStockAllowance, minStockAllowance, maxStockAllowance; hexPercentStockAllowance and hexMinStockWidthAllowance for hex bar), or the Cost Guide's. The stock is bought in the next preferred size at or above it (tblPreferredSizes: inch sizes in USA, metric elsewhere) when snapStockSize is true.

source.engine: outside_size_mm (the part's largest diameter, width across flats, or section side)
allowance_percent (percentStockAllowance; hexPercentStockAllowance for hex bar; 0 when the Cost Guide sets the allowance)
allowance_min_mm (minStockAllowance; hexMinStockWidthAllowance for hex bar; the Cost Guide's allowance when set)
allowance_max_mm (maxStockAllowance; the Cost Guide's allowance when set)

fields.name: Allowance
fields.formula: min({Most Allowance}, max({Least Allowance}, {Allowance Percent} / 100 * {Outside Size}))

calculators.name: Stock Machining - Bar Stock
calculators.description: The bar bought per part. The piece cut for a part is its length plus the stock faced off each end. A bar (standardStockLength) is cut into as many pieces as fit after the end that makes no part, one cut between pieces (the band saw's kerf, bandSawKerf; a parting tool's width, tblPartingRingWidth, on a bar-fed lathe). The end and the cuts are bought with the parts, so each part carries its share of the whole bar, priced per kg for the stock form (material_stock_prices). The data has no yield formula: this rule is the engine's own, agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: part_length_mm (the part's length along the stock)
end_allowance_mm (the stock faced off each end: Stock Machining - Stock Size)
cut_width_mm (bandSawKerf, or the parting ring width on a bar-fed lathe)
section_area_mm2 (the bar's metal cross-section)
bar_end_mm (the end of a bar that makes no part)
density_kg_m3 (the material's density)
price_per_kg (the stock form's price, material_stock_prices)

calculators.name: Stock Machining - Plate Stock
calculators.description: The plate bought per part. The blank is the part's length and width plus the stock left on each side, through a plate of the next preferred thickness. Blanks are cut in a grid on the standard plate (standardPlateLength x standardPlateWidth), a kerf apart, in the better of the two orientations; a blank the standard plate cannot hold is cut from a plate of its own size. Each part carries its share of the whole plate, priced per kg for plate (material_stock_prices). The data has no yield formula: this rule is the engine's own, agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: blank_length_mm (the part's length plus the stock on each end)
blank_width_mm (the part's width plus the stock on each side)
thickness_mm (the plate's thickness: the next preferred size at or above the part's height plus the stock on each face)
plate_length_mm (standardPlateLength, or the blank's when it is larger)
plate_width_mm (standardPlateWidth, or the blank's when it is larger)
parts_per_plate (the blanks of the grid, a kerf apart)
density_kg_m3 (the material's density)
price_per_kg (the plate price, material_stock_prices)

calculators.name: Stock Machining - Band Saw
calculators.description: Band Saw, per part: cutting the stock to pieces. The area cut for one part at the saw's cutting rate for the material's cut-code family and the width in the cut (bandSawCutting: bars cut in a bundle are cut as one section, at the rate for the bundle's width); the stock advanced by one piece and kerf at the saw's axial feed rate, once for the bundle; the bar or plate loaded (bandSawHandling by its weight), shared by the parts it makes; and the piece unloaded (bandSawHandling by its weight). Bundling saves the feeding of each bar, not the cutting of it. The data has no saw cycle formula: this rule is the engine's own, agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: cut_area_mm2 (the stock's section cut for one part; a plate blank's two cut edges through its thickness)
feed_length_mm (the piece and the cut: the stock advanced for each cut)
bars_per_bundle (as many as fit the saw's stock width and height, within maxPartsPerBundleBandSaw and the bars the batch needs)
parts_per_stock (the parts one bar or plate makes)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Cut Time} + {Feed Time} + {Load per Part} + {Unload Time}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Stock Machining - Scrap Credit
calculators.description: What the chips sell for: the stock bought per part less the part's own mass, at the stock's price and the material's Scrap Cost Percent (memory/Stock Maching materials). Taken off the material cost only when enableScrapMaterialCredit is true (false in the data) or the Cost Guide turns it on.

source.engine: mass_per_part_kg (the stock bought per part)
part_mass_kg (the finished part)
price_per_kg (the stock form's price, material_stock_prices)
scrap_cost_percent (the material's Scrap Cost Percent: materialsBandSaw)

fields.name: Scrap Credit
fields.formula: ({Mass per Part} - {Part Mass}) * {Price per kg} * {Scrap Cost Percent} / 100

calculators.name: Stock Machining - Scrap Credit
calculators.description: What the chips sell for: the stock bought per part less the part's own mass, at the stock's price and the material's Scrap Cost Percent (memory/Stock Maching materials), of which the scrap recovery is sold: the location's scrapRecoveryPercent (India: the machining workbook's 95 %, migration 1143), else all of it. Taken off the material cost only when enableScrapMaterialCredit is true (India's, migration 1143; false in the reference data) or the Cost Guide turns it on.

source.engine: mass_per_part_kg (the stock bought per part)
part_mass_kg (the finished part)
price_per_kg (the stock form's price, material_stock_prices)
scrap_cost_percent (the material's Scrap Cost Percent: materialsBandSaw)
scrap_recovery_percent (the location's scrapRecoveryPercent, else 100: the whole scrap weight)

fields.name: Scrap Credit
fields.formula: ({Mass per Part} - {Part Mass}) * {Price per kg} * {Scrap Cost Percent} / 100 * {Scrap Recovery} / 100

calculators.name: Stock Machining - Perimeter Cut
calculators.description: Perimeter Milling with Drop-off, per part: the mill cuts round the part's outline through the plate's thickness, and the rest of the plate drops off. The cut is a slot as wide as the cutter, taken in passes by the slotting rule of Machining - Obround Slot Milling: each pass goes down the Slotting Depth Ratio of the cutter diameter, so the passes are the plate's thickness over that depth, rounded up. Each pass follows the outline and one cutter diameter of lead, at the feed rate the cutter runs at in the material (the standard end mill of tblMillingFinishing: its diameter, teeth, cutting speed and feed per tooth per diameter, the spindle held to the Max Spindle Speed). The time is one more operation of the mill's line (Perimeter Milling). The data names the technique (defaultRoughingTechnique) and has no formula for its cut: this rule is the engine's own, agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: outline_perimeter_mm (the length of the part's outline seen through the plate)
plate_thickness_mm (the plate's thickness: the depth of the cut)
cutter_diameter_mm (the material's standard end mill: tblMillingFinishing)
teeth (the cutter's teeth: tblMillingFinishing)
cutting_speed_m_min (the cutter's cutting speed in the material: tblMillingFinishing)
feed_per_tooth_per_diameter (the cutter's chip load over its diameter: tblMillingFinishing)
max_spindle_rpm (the top spindle speed of the mill that cuts it: mhr_records specs.spindle_speed_rpm, migration 1136)
slotting_depth_ratio (the depth of a slotting pass over the cutter diameter: Machining - Obround Slot Milling)

fields.name: Feed Rate
fields.formula: {Spindle Speed} * {Teeth} * {Feed per Tooth per Diameter} * {Cutter Diameter}
